Units.name: Units
Units.definition: Quantity of units or digital tokens.

OrderDate.name: Order Date
OrderDate.definition: Date the investor or its agent placed the original order.

AcquisitionDate.name: Acquisition Date
AcquisitionDate.definition: Date the investor purchased the financial instrument.

Group1Or2Units.name: Group 1 Or 2 Units
Group1Or2Units.definition: Tax group to which the purchased investment fund units belong. The investor indicates to the intermediary operating pooled nominees, which type of unit is to be sold.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: Reference to the units number. This may be the order reference of the original acquisition, the identification of a lot, a client reference, a sub-position reference or other related reference.
